notes.sowing: Sow outdoors {cm:2.5} deep, or indoors 3 to 5 weeks before planting out in pots you can plant without disturbing the roots. Sow or plant out 2 to 4 weeks after your last frost, once the soil is at least {c:18}.
notes.care: Black plastic mulch warms the soil. Remove row covers when flowers open or days pass {c:32}. Seedless types need a seeded variety nearby to pollinate them. Water {cm:2.5} to {cm:5} a week.
notes.harvest: Watermelons do not slip from the vine. One is ripe when the curly tendril nearest it has browned, the skin turns dull, and the spot where it rests on the ground turns from white to cream or yellow.
